# Local dependencies

Downloaded 2026-09-16 for offline use after starting a local server.

| Asset | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|
| D3 | 7.9.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js |
| TopoJSON client | 3.1.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js |
| World Atlas countries | 2.0.2 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json |
| ISO 3166 lookup | pycountry 24.6.1 | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pycountry/pycountry/24.6.1/src/pycountry/databases/iso3166-1.json |

Library licenses are saved alongside the assets. World Atlas derives its 1:110m boundaries from Natural Earth 4.1.0. Numeric ISO codes join to EM-DAT alpha-3 codes through the ISO lookup. Small territories may be absent from this coarse map. Unmatched records remain in all non-map summaries.
